text:
Maya: tiny holiday PSA — does anyone want to join a 'desk snowflake swap' + plant adoption mini at 2pm on Wed? bring a paper snowflake or a tiny plant (or just come to admire). low-key. :snowflake::seedling:

Ibrahim: in for plants. i've got a pothos that's tired of my watering schedule — will bring with a tiny rescue tag. :houseplant::sweat_smile:

Zoe: snowflake swap yes. can we also do a 'name your plant' quick vote? prizes: the best name gets a sticker.

Carlos: 2pm works. logistics q: is it okay to leave plants on reception for pickup later? i'm commuting light.

ReceptionBot: Reception can hold labeled items for 24 hours. Please prefix packages with "snow-swap". Automated reminder will post 1h before event.

Maya: signup format (copy/paste):
```
Name — plant (dropoff/bring) OR snowflake (paper/dropoff) — allergen note (if snack)
```

Ibrahim: Ibrahim — plant (dropoff) — none

Zoe: Zoe — snowflake (bring) — none

Carlos: Carlos — plant (dropoff) — none

Maya: small rules: label plant species if known, no soil spills (put in a plastic tray), and keep glitter to a minimum on snowflakes.

Zoe: tiny poll: should we have a remote cameo slot? react :wave: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no.

Ibrahim: :wave:

Carlos: :wave:

Maya: remote cameo enabled. we'll do a 2-slot camera cameo for remote folks. also adding a 'plant naming' quick ballot in the thread after show-and-tell.

ReceptionBot: Reminder scheduled: "Desk Snowflake Swap + Plant Rescue" Wed 14:00. Add to calendar? Reply 'yes'.

Maya: last note: if you bring a plant that might have pollen, mark it in the signup line. otherwise, see you for tiny leaves and paper chaos. :seedling::sparkles:
